senses.gloss: श्नु (in gram.) a technical term for the affix नु (added to the root in the 5th class of verbs).

1. स्नु (cf. √ 1. स्ना) cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 29) स्नौति (accord. to Vop. also स्नुते; only in pres. base; Gr. also pf. सुष्णाव, सुष्णुवे; fut. स्नोता or स्नविता &c.),
to drip, distil, trickle, emit fluid, yield milk, BhP. (cf. प्र-√ स्नु) :
Caus. स्नावयति (aor. असुष्णवत्) Gr.:
Desid. of Caus. सिस्नावयिषति or सुस्नावयिषति, ib. :
Desid. सुस्नूषति, ib. :
Intens. सोष्णूयते, सिष्णवीति, सोष्णोति, ib. [cf. Gk. νέω, νεύσομαι].
2. स्नु (ifc.) dripping, trickling, sprinkling (see घृत-स्नु).

3. स्नु॑ n. (accord. to L. also m. abridged fr. सानु and occurring only in instr. abl. sg., स्नु॑ना, स्नो॑स् ; and in instr. loc. pl. स्नु॑भिस्, स्नु॑षु) the level summit or edge of a mountain, table-land, surface, height, RV.; VS.
4. स्नु f. = स्नायु, a sinew, tendon, muscle (only occurring in स्नु-तस्, ‘from the sinews or muscles’), BhP.
5. स्नु a Kṛd-anta affix to roots forming adjectives expressive of an aptitude to do what is implied by the root, Vop.
श्नुष्टि f. (prob.) either ‘a little heap’ or ‘a small measure’ (for measuring grain), Kāṭh.
श्नुष्टि m. N. of an Āṅgirasa, PañcavBr.
स्नुत mfn. trickling, flowing (esp. said of milk flowing from a mother's breast), BhP.
स्नुति f. trickling, distilling, stream, flow, MW.
स्नुघ्निका (?) f. natron, mineral alkali, L.
स्नुच् (prob. for √ स्तुच्) cl. 1. Ā. स्नोचते, to be bright or clear, L.
स्नुषा॑ f. (accord. to some connected with सूनु) the son's wife, a daughter-in-law, AV. &c. &c.
the spurge plant (= स्नुही), L.
स्नुषा [cf. Gk. νυός; Lat. nurus; Slav. snǔcha; Angl.Sax. snoru; Germ. snura, snur, Schnur.]
स्नुषा—ग mfn. having sexual intercourse with a daughter-in-law, Ml.
स्नुषा—त्व n. the condition of a d˚-in-law, Rājat.
स्नुषा—वत् ind. like (with) a d˚-in-law, Mn. viii, 62.
स्नुषा—श्वशुरीया f. (scil. इष्टि) a sacrifice intended to subdue an adversary as a daughter-in-law is subject to a father-in-law, ĀśvŚr.

1. स्नुह् cl. 4. P. स्नुह्यति, to vomit, Dhātup. xxvi, 90;
to be moist (= √ स्निह्, see स्नूहन्).
2. स्नुह् mfn. (nom. स्नुक् or स्नुट्) vomiting, one who vomits, MW.
स्नुह् f. a kind of spurge, Euphorbia Antiquorum (its milky juice is used as an emetic &c.; it has 17 synonyms, cf. सीहुण्ड &c.), Car.; Suśr.
स्नुक् in comp. for 2. स्नुह्.
स्नुक्—छद m. a kind of reed, Lipeocercis Serrata, L.
स्नुहा and स्नुहि, f. id., Hcar.
स्नुहा and स्नुहि, f. id., Hcar.
स्नुही f. id., Suśr.
स्नूहन् m. the mucus of the nose, ĀpŚr.
